independently_checked_findings: The literal source is fixed-root directed spanning out-arborescence with arbitrary destination-specific arc vectors, distinct from all-roots Problem1.
Primary 2010 and 2019 reproductions use one unit root-to-destination flow per nonroot vertex, individually bounded by common capacities, and cardinality equality n-1.
At integral capacities on the cardinality face, supported flow variables uniquely encode tree paths; integral projection does not establish full joint-extension integrality.
Goemans-Myung1993 p23 explicitly records nonintegrality of coupled Q_xf despite integral Q_x projection for T=V; its attribution is Martin1986 working paper, not Martin1991.
Wong1978, Magnanti-Wong1984, Costa2005, VanVyve-Wolsey2004/2006, and ZIB08-29 do not by their inspected proofs establish the candidate's restricted theorem.
Unrestricted negative-cost hardness is an explicit audit corollary of Karp1972 directed Hamilton-circuit completeness; no nonnegative DAG consequence is claimed from it.
